title.value: A portrait of the different configurations between digitally-enabled innovations and climate governance
title.justification: The paper explicitly explores the configurations between digital technologies and climate governance as part of its investigation into digital-enabled initiatives.
title.quote: A portrait of the different configurations between digitally-enabled innovations and climate governance

extractions.description: This paper analyzes various digitally-enabled initiatives aimed at climate governance. It classifies these initiatives into four strategies: data mobilization, optimization of existing strategies, incentivizing and automating behavioral change, and enhancing participation and empowerment. The paper uses the Earth System Governance framework to evaluate these strategies concerning architecture, agency, adaptiveness, accountability, and allocation & access. It aims to understand how these digital strategies contribute to reimagining climate governance and achieving climate mitigation goals.

climate_change_is_central.justification: The paper's primary focus is on how digitally-enabled innovations contribute to climate governance and mitigation efforts, illustrating its centrality to the theme of climate change.
climate_change_is_central.quote: We seek to explore the potential of transformations in and of governance regimes. We know that climate mitigation governance has thus far not been able to effectively address the scale of the climate crisis.

primary_category.justification: The paper focuses on digitally-enabled innovations for climate mitigation through governance strategies to limit global warming as per the Paris Agreement.
primary_category.quote: This work provides a first step towards understanding how digitally-enabled initiatives are contributing to re-imagining climate governance.

secondary_categories.justification: The paper discusses the role of governance in societal transformations necessary for climate change adaptation.
secondary_categories.quote: Exploring the governance and politics of transformations towards sustainability.

secondary_categories.justification: It discusses the use of data and technologies for tracking and decision-making in climate science and governance.
secondary_categories.quote: Satellite, drone imagery, and remote sensing help monitor environmental conditions and are leveraged to provide support for different climate initiatives.

primary_sub_category.justification: The paper identifies data mobilization and transparency as key strategies within governance to reduce GHG emissions, aligning with this sub-category.
primary_sub_category.quote: These initiatives strive to provide more accurate, comprehensive, or easily accessible data to inform evidence-based decisions.

secondary_sub_categories.justification: Discussion on incentivizing behavioral change through efficient energy use aligns with initiatives discussed in this sub-category.
secondary_sub_categories.quote: The incentivizing and automating behavioural change category often focuses on improving energy use efficiency.

secondary_sub_categories.justification: The paper involves coordination between digital initiatives and climate governance frameworks for policy enhancement.
secondary_sub_categories.quote: We propose a categorization of four types of strategies: ... enhancing participation and empowerment of individuals.

applications.justification: The paper emphasizes leveraging digital technologies to increase data access and transparency for effective climate governance.
applications.quote: Data mobilization strategies are employed more frequently by initiatives whose aim is to support renewable energy or carbon policies.

applications.value: Incentivizing behavioral change for energy efficiency
applications.justification: The discussion on incentives for reducing energy expenditure and behavioral change indicates this specific application.
applications.quote: The goal of these initiatives is to influence human behaviour through targeted information sharing, rewards-based mechanisms, or automating behavioural changes.

new_primary_category.justification: The paper fits well within the existing Climate Change Mitigation category, specifically focusing on digital strategies for governance.
new_primary_category.quote: There is a proliferation of climate action leveraging digital technol­ogies that have emerged over the past decade.

new_primary_sub_category.justification: The sub-categories such as Monitoring, Reporting and Verification already encompass the paper's discussion on data-based governance strategies.
new_primary_sub_category.quote: This database should not be regarded as comprehensive but as indicative and representative of the emergence of experimentation and potential for leverage points in the digitally-empowered climate governance space.
